translation: One name is 女雷, one name 女理, one name 兒草, one name 鹿列, one name 韭逢, one name 兒踵草, one name 東根, one name 水須, one name 沈燔, one name . It grows in Henei. Gather the root in the second and eighth months
translator_notes: The last alias contains an unreadable character transliterated as blank.
